annotations.title: Zodiac sign dates of a year

description: When the Sun enters each zodiac sign in a given year (1900–2100), to the minute, in a time zone (Polish time by default). With a sign, also its usual first and last day and the earliest and latest entry across 1900–2100. For "what is my sign" when someone is born near the edge of two signs.

lang.description: Language of the names in the answer: pl (default) or en

sign.description: Only this sign, e.g. aries or baran (optional)

tz.description: IANA time zone of the times (default Europe/Warsaw)

name: sign_dates
title: Zodiac sign dates of a year
